description: This file defines a PHP class BeanListResponse within the Api\V8\BeanDecorator namespace. The class encapsulates a list of SugarBean objects and a row count, providing constructor and getter methods to access these properties.

classes.name: BeanListResponse
classes.description: A class representing a response containing a list of SugarBean objects and associated metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BeanListResponse object with data from an array, setting the beans list and row count.

methods.name: getBeans
methods.description: Returns the list of SugarBean objects.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the row count indicating the number of beans.
